text:
maria (finops): Morning — noticed an ~18% jump in daily burn for the GPU fleet yesterday. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/finops/daily-burn. Can infra help triage per-model / per-route cost breakdown?

devin (eng-infra): On it. Last export shows spikes in us-west-2 GPUs for model `llama-13b-q4`. Could be untagged routes falling back to high-cost instances.

bill (cloud-billing-bot): Automated billing export processed for 2026-02-14: total cloud spend $1,245,900; GPU spend $412,300 (+22% vs prior week). CSV: gs://billing-exports/2026/02/14/billing.csv

alex (eng-sre): FYI we had a networking flap in us-west-2 ~02:10UTC that triggered some cross-region reroutes. Might explain extra egress and fallback to spare capacity.

sara (finance): If the spike persists we'll blow past our monthly committed target. Current reserved commitments utilization is 72% across regions. Need a commitment plan review before the next invoice.

tony (eng-platform): Noticed many inference routes lack the `route_id` tag — cost aggregation is underreporting per-route. I'll push a lint rule to the router to make `route_id` required for prod.

devin (eng-infra): Quick SQL to get per-model cost from the billing export:
```
SELECT model, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.export
WHERE service = 'GPU' AND _PARTITIONDATE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```

maria (finops): Thanks — can someone run that and paste top 5 models? Also run a per-route slice for the last 7 days.

devin (eng-infra): Top 5 by GPU cost (7d window): `llama-13b-q4` $122k, `redwood-vicuna-7b` $64k, `codefuse-2.1` $38k, `sales-summary` $22k, `chat-lite` $19k.

sara (finance): `llama-13b-q4` is the big one. Is that on Dedicated pools or Hosted? If we can pin high-cost tenants to Dedicated they should be eligible for committed discounts.

alex (eng-sre): It's mixed. Some heavy customers hit Hosted shared capacity. We can move them to Dedicated but we need expected QPS to size reservations.

maria (finops): Quick back-of-envelope — if we reserve 100 p50 GPUs in us-west-2 for 1yr (mixed types), est monthly commit ~$280k vs current monthly GPU spend ~ $1.2M. Need to model utilization. What's break-even?

devin (eng-infra): Rough calc: at 65% utilization projected savings ~28% vs on-demand. Break-even ~9 months. I'll run the optimizer for more precise numbers and sensitivity.

tony (eng-platform): Actions: 1) enforce `route_id` tags (tony); 2) run commitment optimizer for 1yr vs 3yr scenarios (devin); 3) list candidate customers to onboard to Dedicated (alex & maria); 4) add per-model cost widget to FinOps dashboard (maria). Timeline: updates by EOD Friday?

sara (finance): Also validate committed billing coverage across regions — committing only in us-west-2 won't help if cross-region failovers keep causing eu-west-1 spend.

alex (eng-sre): I'll add a failover policy to prefer region-local cached instances and a circuit-breaker to avoid cross-region spinups during network issues.

maria (finops): Great. Please drop short notes here when done. Devin please paste optimizer results and recommended commit sizes. Tony please link the PR for `route_id` lint.

devin (eng-infra): Running optimizer now, will have CSV of scenarios in ~3 hours. Added sensitivity for 50%/75% utilization. Top scenarios: `1yr-mixed-100gpus-util65.csv`, `3yr-mixed-120gpus-util75.csv`. Links: gs://finops-reports/commitment-scenarios/.

tony (eng-platform): PR: https://git.redwood/internal/router/pulls/421 — adds required `route_id` header check for prod routes, includes migration steps and a shortbackwards-compat grace period.

maria (finops): Scheduling a quick 1h sync at 15:30 to review outputs. :calendar: @devin @alex @sara @tony

sara (finance): +1. Also request sensitivity for utilization variance and latency impact on moving customers.

devin (eng-infra): Will include utilization sensitivity and per-model tail-latency cost delta.

maria (finops): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the sync and finalize a recommendation for commit sizes and regions. :white_check_mark:
